survey: A stage spotlight hanging from a section of truss. The truss has two parallel horizontal tubes joined by diagonal braces, with short vertical end pieces closing each end; it is shown as a cut-out section, which is normal for a card. A clamp block grips both tubes at the centre and is held by a visible bolt. A short vertical stem drops from the clamp to a swivel collar on top of a U-shaped yoke. The yoke's arms come down both sides of the cylindrical lamp body. The right arm ends in a round tilt knob on the body's side, and the left arm goes behind the body toward the hidden side pivot. The lamp body has vent slots on top and a stepped front bezel. The front lens holds three LEDs (yellow, cyan, red) that face the camera and point down-left, and each one casts a beam of matching colour. There is no power cable, which counts as an acceptable simplification.
